concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a complete, shippable desktop web application screen for MajorPilot, a Chinese postgraduate-major exploration website, at 1536x1024. This is the P2 generic workbench tutorial, NOT an AI/DS/BA assessment. Same established editorial visual system: warm paper #F7F5EE, ink #171A1D, ultramarine #304FFE, tiny vermilion #F45B35; bold clean Chinese sans, selective serif step numeral, clear small control typography, no green, no gradients/glow, no decorative cards. Vue 3 implementation; all text/tables/controls will be native HTML, not a screenshot UI. No photos or sculpture in this focused workbench. Full three-column screen with top bar and bottom step controls. Header MajorPilot wordmark and small blue-orange twofold paper-flight mark at far left; '工作区上手：读取与调整' title in header, right status '已保存' and text action '暂停并返回'. No marketing navbar. Left rail width 224px with orange oversized serif '03', label '任务步骤', open separated rows '01 准备工作区' and '02 读取合成样本' with simple checked marks; current blue rule beside '03 调整参数并预览'; muted upcoming '04 记录观察', '05 提交任务', '06 体验反思'. Center wide 840px, right help rail 280px, generous readable margins, vertical thin rules only. Center title '调整参数并预览' 40px bold; subtitle '只改一个参数，观察结果如何变化。' 18px. Quiet inset table with columns '样本' and '数值'; rows 'S01  2', 'S02  5', 'S03  8', 'S04  11'. Below table one horizontal control row: label '倍数' with 1 2 3 radio choices, 2 selected; label '样本范围' with select '全部样本'. Below controls secondary outlined '运行预览' button. Results as a simple open three-column strip with labels '样本数' '总和' '平均值' and respective values '4' '52' '13', separated fine rules; text '结果仅来自这份合成样本。' Show small link '查看计算说明'. Bottom '上一步' text-arrow left and black primary button with ultramarine thin edge '完成此步骤' plus small blue circular arrow at right. Help rail title '需要一点提示？', text '先自己尝试。你可以按需逐层查看提示。', three unboxed rows '01 概念方向', '02 操作思路', '03 一个具体线索'; active outlined '查看一级提示' button. Footer rail text '演示不生成专业报告'. No fake scores, fit rankings, chat bubbles, analytics, extra navigation, lorem ipsum, browser frame, annotations, or invented claims. Full readable real app screen at native scale, crisp Chinese text. Practical code-native production design, accessible contrasts, beautiful restrained editorial hierarchy.

Use case: ui-mockup. Complete desktop reflection screen for MajorPilot at 1536x1024, a Chinese major exploration web app. Extend its established sparse editorial system: warm paper #F7F5EE, ink #171A1D, ultramarine #304FFE, tiny orange #F45B35, bold Chinese sans headings, intentional 16–18px UI text and thin separator rules. This P2 screen closes a generic 6–10 minute workbench tutorial, not a professional assessment; no report promised. Native Vue form design with no artwork needed, no rounded card stacks, no gradients. Header existing MajorPilot black wordmark+small blue/orange mark, task name '工作区上手：读取与调整', right '已保存' and '暂停反思并返回'. Open centered two-column composition: left slim rail with oversized orange serif '06' and '体验反思'; form main column about800px starting x420. Heading '回顾这次体验' at44px; description '没有标准答案，只记录你自己的感受。'. Form group1 '哪个环节最吸引你？' and note '可选1–3项，或选择没有特别感兴趣的环节。'; 2-row open checkbox grid options '读取样本' '调整参数' '记录观察' '没有特别感兴趣的环节'. First selected. Thin horizontal divider. Group2 '困难主要来自哪里？' checkbox choices '知识' '工具' '时间' '任务方式' '其他' '没有明显困难', tools selected. Group3 '你愿意继续做类似的工作吗？' three radio choices '愿意' '不确定' '暂时不想', middle selected. Group4 collapsed optional native disclosure '补充感受与下一步偏好（可选）' with clear down chevron. Bottom black primary button with blue slim edge and circular arrow '提交并完成演示', left secondary '返回任务回顾'; below '演示不生成专业报告，也不会影响你的专业选择。'. Spacious but ensure allgroupsandbuttonvisible1024height, topbar76high, contentstart140, h144,fontlineheight1.5,compactcheckboxrows. Focused reflection not marketing page. All title, labels, answers, selected marks and buttons must be native HTML in implementation, not image baked. No invented ratings, capability scores, fake reports, AI chat, extra question, optional AI asrequired, lorem ipsum, browser chrome, shadows, or new product modules. Render crisp faithful Chinese copy and complete usable form surface.
